description: Hermetic tests (plan v3 H1, D-069 item 5): network denied, seeded randomness, injected clock, timeouts.

tests.check_roots.description: Prefixes of the repository whose test files (test_*.py, *_test.py, *.test.ts/mjs, not *.int.test.ts) the hermetic check judges.

tests.clock_start.description: RFC 3339 instant at which the injected test clock starts; tests advance it explicitly and never read the wall clock.

tests.config_store.description: The configuration change store a hermetic test process reads: this checkout's local log, never the shared store on the forge (D-069 item 5). hermetic.install() pins it for the process and hermetic.store_env() gives it to a child process whose environment a test builds. Read from this file, never from the store itself.

tests.harness_files.description: Test files that prove the harness itself and so must call the forbidden forms (a socket to a refused host). The hermetic check does not judge them; any other file is judged.

tests.loopback_hosts.description: Hosts a hermetic test may still reach: its own fixture servers on the loopback interface.

tests.network_allowed.description: When false, unit and script tests cannot open a connection to any host outside tests.loopback_hosts: connect, UDP send and name resolution raise. True is an explicit, audited exception.

tests.random_seed.description: Seed of every random source in script tests: Python's random module (scripts/lib/hermetic.py). The same seed gives the same run (D-069 item 5).

tests.script_timeout_ms.description: Per-test timeout of Python script tests. They had no bound before H1; this one equals the longest explicit subprocess timeout those tests already use (600 s, the toolchain bootstrap of a fresh gate checkout), so a hung test fails instead of stalling the gate and no test that passed before fails. Tightened only by measurement (D-069 items 5, 14).

tests.unhermetic_sites.description: Test files that predate the hermetic rules, as path:RULE (wall_clock, random, socket). Against the base this list only shrinks; a new site is refused. Each entry is a debt for the file's unit owner (U0 manifests), fixed by injecting the clock, seeding the source or using a loopback fixture. The harness sites are the tests that run scripts/cloud/setup.sh, the toolchain bootstrap that downloads by design (hermetic.without_harness); they stay listed while those tests exist.
